subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “It is also about communication.”?
options: People need quiet spaces before the world enters.
People still need to ask why it keeps becoming full and what should change.
Sometimes people need to see waste clearly before they believe it is real.
People need to know what a chart means before fear fills the empty spaces.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「People need quiet spaces before the world enters.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「People still need to ask why it keeps becoming full and what should change.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Sometimes people need to see waste clearly before they believe it is real.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「It is also about communication. People need to know what a chart means before fear fills the empty spaces.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
